line.comment: * Zero Hour 2.0 - sectors and jump beacons cost upkeep but without additional consequences if you cannot pay. Only on harder difficulties.
* Add-Ons 1.3: Maintenance cost of both sectors and beacons increased by 50% on insane difficulty.
* Add-Ons 1.6.1: Calculate current supply and total supply here. This is a big calculation, so we don't do this inside loops if we can.
* Increase maintenance factor if we don't have a Mobile Maintenance Kit and if we're not docked. Doesn't increase if maintenance is free.
* ZH 2.1 fighters deteriorate twice as fast
* to keep the original balance we increase the factor 5 times more. But only if player doesnt use a custom maintenance cycle
* Expanded 2.2: Maintenance can be paid from all player accounts.
* If the full maintenance cost cannot be paid, all available funds are consumed and the ship is damaged.
